records.title: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid and Yale Scholarship (International Students)
records.deadline_display: Yale publishes separate aid-document deadlines: "QuestBridge: November 1; Early Action: November 1 (US Citizens/Permanent Residents), December 1 (International Citizens); Regular Decision: February 15; Transfer: April 1; Eli Whitney: April 1."
records.application_period: Annual cycle matched to Yale's admission rounds; international citizens have a December 1 Early Action aid-document deadline and a February 15 Regular Decision deadline.

records.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
records.official_source: New Zealand Government (Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme, administered by Education New Zealand | Manapou ki te Ao)
records.deadline_display: The official site states: "Tertiary applications for the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme have now closed." The only dated window published on the pages read is the Samoa Foundation round: "Applications for Samoa Foundation open midnight 4 August 2026 and close midday 4 September 2026". The awarding body also warns that "the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme application system may close early to countries with a large volume of applications".
records.application_period: Annual round with country- and region-specific opening and closing dates published on the official site; the 2026 tertiary round has closed and the next round's dates are not yet published.

records.title: University of Glasgow Sanctuary Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Applications for this scholarship for the 2027-28 academic session will open soon. In the meantime please provide your details and we will be in touch when the scholarship is open for applications.
records.application_period: For the 2027/28 academic year the scholarship is announced and not yet open for applications: the University states applications 'will open soon' and invites applicants to register their interest in the meantime. No opening date or closing date has been published for the 2027/28 cycle.

records.title: Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships
records.official_source: Ministry of Education Transformation, Government of Barbados
